option_relations.rationale: Blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm (BPDCN) is a distinct hematologic malignancy and not equivalent to Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia.
Lymphomatous meningitis is a complication of lymphoma, which is a different type of hematologic malignancy than Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia.
Paraneoplastic polyradiculoneuropathy is a neurological syndrome associated with cancer, but it is not the same entity as Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia.
Paraneoplastic neurological syndrome is a broad category and not equivalent to Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia.
